name: BALROG
description: BALROG is a benchmark designed to assess the agentic reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) through a diverse set of challenging games. It includes reinforcement learning environments with varying difficulty levels and fine-grained metrics to evaluate complex interactions, spatial reasoning, long-term planning, and exploration.
reputation: Open and user-friendly benchmark with a public leaderboard to facilitate research in agentic capabilities.
notes: Includes a range of RL environments from easy to extremely challenging; highlights deficiencies in vision-based decision-making.
